answer: Without a whisper the brick has no maker, without a grove it has no weight, and without a copper it has no firing — and a farm's brick is missing all three at once. A forged receipt fails at the first cross-check, because the issuer keeps a copy of its own. The threshold charges in days as well as coins: 11 days to cure a proof, and a farm cannot cure 315 proofs any faster. Where the farms spot a gap, Engraver portrait plate warrant engraved into the etching press finds a record, and the record is each portrait plate is a measured plate yield plus an engraver signature.
